title: Surreal Fairy in Mirror World
description: A central female figure with large iridescent green wings stands in a highly detailed surreal dreamscape. She wears a mirrored disco-ball style bodice covered in flowers and a floral crown, raising one hand toward a beam of light as melting clocks, floating eyeballs, jellyfish, silver apples, and a distant futuristic city framed like a portal fill the cosmic background.
prompt: A beautiful woman with large translucent green fairy wings stands at the center of a surreal dream world, wearing a reflective mirrored disco ball bodice adorned with colorful flowers and a flower crown. One arm raised toward a heavenly light beam. Floating eyeballs, blue jellyfish, melting Dali clocks, silver apples, stone ruins, and a golden futuristic city visible through a large ornate mirror portal. Cosmic space background with dramatic lighting, highly detailed surreal fantasy scene.
